description: This file defines the EntityUniquePropertyOption class, which is part of validation rules within the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates options for validating the uniqueness of entity properties, including trimming functions, ignore values, and match criteria.

classes.name: EntityUniquePropertyOption
classes.description: A class to specify options for validating the uniqueness of entity properties during validation processes.

methods.description: Constructor initializing default trim function and ignoreValues.

methods.description: Retrieves the closure used to trim input values.

methods.name: setTrimFunction
